name: Informatica Data Integration
tools: Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (Cloud Data Integration)

beginner.summary: For ETL developers and data engineers new to Informatica. Covers the product family, IDMC and the Secure Agent, connections, mappings, sources and targets, core transformations, expressions, lookups, joiners, aggregators, routers and filters, sorters and rank, mapping tasks and parameters, taskflows, error handling, incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions, PowerCenter basics, monitoring and good mapping design.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins and aggregation
Understands data warehouse basics: facts, dimensions and staging
outcomes: Build and run mappings in Informatica Cloud Data Integration
Use core transformations to clean, join, aggregate and route data
Load incrementally and build slowly changing dimensions
Schedule, monitor and troubleshoot jobs and read PowerCenter work

days.topic: Informatica Overview, IDMC and Secure Agent Setup
subtopics: PowerCenter and Intelligent Data Management Cloud
IDMC services: Data Integration, Application Integration, Data Quality and more
The Secure Agent and runtime environments
Installing a Secure Agent on Windows or Linux
The course project: retail sales warehouse
days.lab_task: Create an IDMC trial organisation, install a Secure Agent, check its services are running, create a project structure and record what each IDMC service does.
days.deliverable: Agent status screenshot, project structure and service notes
checks: Status up with Data Integration service running
Folders for sources, staging and warehouse

days.topic: Connections to Databases, Files and Cloud Applications
subtopics: Relational connections: Oracle, SQL Server and PostgreSQL
Cloud warehouse connections: Snowflake and others
days.lab_task: Create connections to a SQL Server source, a flat file folder and a Snowflake target, test each through the Secure Agent and apply naming standards.

days.topic: Mappings: Sources, Targets and Data Flow
subtopics: Running a mapping with a mapping task
Target operations: insert, update, upsert and delete
days.lab_task: Build a mapping that copies customers from SQL Server to a Snowflake staging table, preview data, validate the mapping and run it with a mapping task.
checks: Target row count matches the source

subtopics: Conditional logic with IIF and DECODE
days.lab_task: Clean customer data with an Expression transformation: trim and standardise names, parse dates, derive an age band and handle nulls.
checks: Consistent case and no extra spaces
Valid dates converted and bad ones flagged

days.lab_task: Route orders into valid, suspect and invalid targets with a Router, filter test data at the source and count rows in each output.
checks: Each group receives the right rows

days.lab_task: Join orders with customers from another system, look up product categories with a cached lookup, handle missing products and compare join and lookup approaches.
checks: Row count as expected for the join type

days.lab_task: Summarise daily sales by store and product, rank the top five products per store and remove duplicate rows with a Sorter.

subtopics: Java and Python transformations in brief
Hierarchy transformations for JSON and XML
days.lab_task: Turn monthly columns into rows with a Normaliser, combine three regional files with a Union, generate surrogate keys and parse a JSON order file.
Parameterise the source query date range and connections, build a mapplet for address cleaning used by two mappings and run with a parameter file.
days.deliverable: Parameterised mapping, mapplet and parameter file
checks: Both mappings clean addresses the same way

days.lab_task: Build a taskflow that loads staging tables in parallel, then dimensions and facts, sends a notification and starts when a file arrives.
checks: Notification sent and later steps skipped

days.lab_task: Send invalid rows to an error table with reasons, stop the job when errors pass a threshold and reprocess fixed rows.
days.deliverable: Mapping, error table and reprocessing evidence
checks: Rows in the error table with reasons

days.lab_task: Load orders incrementally with an in-out parameter watermark, detect changed customers with hashes and handle deleted source rows.
Build a type 2 customer dimension that keeps history with effective dates and a current flag, and test address changes and repeated loads.
checks: New row added and old row closed

days.topic: Loading Facts and Building a Star Schema
days.lab_task: Load the sales fact table with surrogate key lookups and unknown members, build a daily aggregate and reconcile totals with the source.
checks: All rows have dimension keys or unknown members
Dimensions before facts in the taskflow

days.topic: Loading Cloud Data Warehouses with Pushdown Optimisation
subtopics: What can and cannot be pushed down
days.lab_task: Load the warehouse in Snowflake with and without full pushdown, read the generated SQL and compare run times and warehouse cost.
checks: Transformations run as SQL in Snowflake

subtopics: PowerCenter architecture: repository, integration service and clients
Designer, Workflow Manager and Workflow Monitor
PowerCenter compared with Cloud Data Integration
days.lab_task: Open an existing PowerCenter workflow, trace a mapping from source to target, read a failed session log and change a parameter file to re-run it.

days.topic: Monitoring Jobs and Reading Session Logs
days.lab_task: Diagnose four failed jobs from their logs (a connection failure, a data type error, a lookup cache problem and a target constraint error) and fix each.

days.topic: Profiling and Cleansing Data in Informatica
days.lab_task: Profile customer data, create cleansing and standardisation rules, use them in the load mapping and build a scorecard.

days.topic: Good Mapping Design and Development Standards
days.lab_task: Review three poorly built mappings against a standards checklist, fix naming, complexity and documentation problems and export the fixed assets to version control.
days.deliverable: Fixed mappings, review notes and exported assets
checks: Fewer transformations with the same output

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Retail Sales Data Warehouse Load
days.lab_task: Build the retail warehouse load: staging from files and SQL Server, cleansing, SCD type 2 customers, facts with surrogate keys, incremental loads, error handling and a scheduled taskflow, then demo it with reconciliation.
days.deliverable: Mappings, taskflow, reconciliation and demo recording
checks: Load bad rows during the demo
Rejected with reasons and the load continues
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one load

intermediate.summary: For Informatica developers who run production loads. Covers performance tuning, partitioning, advanced lookups, advanced transformations, dynamic mappings, mass ingestion, CDC, Application Integration and APIs, data quality in depth, master data concepts, metadata and lineage with the data catalogue, deployment between environments, the REST API, Secure Agent operations, security, operational monitoring, PowerCenter to cloud migration, Spark and elastic mappings, testing and certification preparation.
prerequisites: Builds mappings and taskflows with core transformations
Loads warehouses with incremental and SCD logic
Reads session logs to fix failures
outcomes: Tune and scale data integration jobs
Build dynamic, CDC and API-based integrations
Govern data with quality, catalogue and lineage
Deploy, secure, operate and migrate Informatica workloads

days.topic: Performance Tuning for Mappings and Tasks
subtopics: Finding bottlenecks: source, transformation or target
days.lab_task: Tune a slow load by finding its bottleneck, tuning the source query, lookup caches and commit settings, and recording each change and its effect.
Partition a large fact load by key range, run independent loads in parallel and measure throughput and agent resource use.
Use a dynamic lookup cache to detect new and changed rows in one pass, share a persistent cache between two tasks and measure memory use.
checks: New and changed rows flagged in one pass

subtopics: Loading many tables with one mapping
days.lab_task: Build one dynamic mapping that loads 20 staging tables with field rules, add a column to a source and confirm it flows through.
days.deliverable: Dynamic mapping, task list and drift test
checks: New column appears in the target
Cases unsuitable for dynamic mappings listed

days.topic: Mass Ingestion for Files, Databases and Streams
subtopics: Database ingestion: initial and incremental loads
days.lab_task: Ingest a whole SQL Server schema to a cloud warehouse with database ingestion, then incremental changes, and land daily files in cloud storage with file ingestion.
Capture changes from SQL Server logs, apply them to the warehouse, stop and restart the job and measure lag under load.
Build a process that receives an order through a REST API, validates it, writes it to a database and calls a shipping API, and expose it securely.
days.deliverable: Process, API definition and test results

subtopics: Parsing and standardising addresses and names
days.lab_task: Build rule specifications for customer data, match and merge duplicates, route exceptions for review and track quality trends over a month of loads.
days.deliverable: Rules, match results and trend scorecard

subtopics: MDM styles: registry, consolidation and centralised
days.lab_task: Design a customer master for a company with three systems, define match and survivorship rules for the golden record and plan stewardship.
days.deliverable: MDM design, rules and stewardship plan
checks: Rules find true duplicates in sample data
Golden record fields chosen with rules

days.topic: Metadata, Lineage and the Data Catalogue
days.lab_task: Scan the warehouse and mappings, link glossary terms to columns, trace lineage from source to report and run impact analysis for a column change.
days.deliverable: Catalogue entries, lineage and impact report

days.lab_task: Promote a project from development to test with export and import, switch connections by environment and set up Git integration for assets.
days.deliverable: Release package, import log and Git history

days.topic: Automating with the IDMC REST API
subtopics: Exporting and importing through the API
days.lab_task: Write Python scripts that start a taskflow, wait for its result, export a project and update a connection through the REST API.

days.topic: Secure Agent Operations and High Availability
days.lab_task: Create an agent group with two agents, stop one during a job, size agents for the workload and fix an agent that cannot reach the cloud.
checks: Agent back online after the fix

days.lab_task: Set up roles for developers and operators, restrict production assets, turn on SSO, mask personal data for test environments and review audit logs.
checks: Edit a production asset as a developer

days.lab_task: Build an operations dashboard for nightly loads, alert on failures and late finishes, write runbooks for the top failures and report service levels for a month.
checks: Alert sent with a runbook link

days.topic: Migrating from PowerCenter to Cloud Data Integration
days.lab_task: Assess a sample PowerCenter repository, convert three workflows to Cloud Data Integration, fix conversion problems and validate outputs against PowerCenter.
days.deliverable: Assessment, converted assets and validation report

days.lab_task: Run a large JSON processing mapping in advanced mode on Spark, compare time and cost with standard mode and pushdown and choose the right engine.
checks: Mapping runs on the Spark cluster

days.lab_task: Write unit tests with fixed test data for three mappings, automate reconciliation tests in Python and run a regression suite after a change.
Take a timed practice exam, rebuild wrong answers in IDMC, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Near-Real-Time Customer Data Hub
days.lab_task: Build a customer data hub fed by CDC and mass ingestion, with quality rules and deduplication, an API for lookups, lineage in the catalogue, environment promotion and monitoring, then demo a failure and recovery.
days.deliverable: Assets, catalogue entries, dashboards and demo recording
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one hub

advanced.summary: For senior integration engineers and architects. Covers integration architecture, IDMC platform design, high-volume performance, CDC at scale, real-time and event-driven integration, API management, enterprise data quality, MDM implementation, governance programmes, privacy and masking, DevOps and CI/CD, large migrations, hybrid and multi-cloud, cost, AI with CLAIRE, platform operations, alternatives, production troubleshooting and integration strategy.
prerequisites: Runs production Informatica workloads with CDC, quality and APIs
outcomes: Design enterprise integration and governance on IDMC
Run high-volume, real-time and hybrid integration reliably
Lead migrations, DevOps and cost control
Choose and justify integration tools and strategy

subtopics: Integration patterns: batch, CDC, streaming and APIs
Integration layers in a data platform
Where Informatica fits with warehouses and lakes
days.lab_task: Design integration for a bank with 40 source systems, choose patterns per source, place IDMC in the platform and defend the design in a review.
days.deliverable: Architecture, decision records and review notes
checks: Pattern justified for each source group

days.topic: IDMC Platform Design: Organisations, Runtimes and Environments
days.lab_task: Design the IDMC organisation structure, runtimes and environments for three business units with data in two clouds and on-premises, and estimate IPU consumption.
checks: Agents close to each data source

subtopics: End-to-end tuning across source, agent and target
days.lab_task: Tune a 500-million-row nightly load to finish within the window, record each change and add a regression test that fails if run time grows by 20 percent.

days.topic: CDC at Scale and Replication Design
subtopics: Initial loads and switchover to CDC
days.lab_task: Replicate 300 tables with CDC, change a source schema, recover after a long outage with resynchronisation and keep lag within the target.
days.deliverable: Replication design, test results and capacity plan

subtopics: Streaming ingestion to Kafka and cloud streams
When real time is worth it
days.lab_task: Stream order events through Kafka into the warehouse and an operational API, handle duplicates and late events and compare cost with a 15-minute batch.
days.deliverable: Flows, test results and cost comparison
objectives: Decide when to use real time

days.lab_task: Publish integration APIs with rate limits, OAuth and versioning, document them in a developer portal and monitor use.
checks: Calls and errors per API shown

subtopics: Quality at entry and in pipelines
Root cause analysis for bad data
days.lab_task: Define critical data elements for customer and product data, build a shared rule library, set up stewardship and report quality trends to leadership.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, rule library and leadership report

days.lab_task: Implement a customer master with matching, survivorship and stewardship, publish golden records to two systems and measure duplicate reduction.
days.deliverable: MDM configuration, published records and results
checks: False matches reduced on test data

days.topic: Data Governance Programmes with the Catalogue
days.lab_task: Set up glossary ownership, classify personal data automatically, publish data products in the marketplace with access requests and report governance metrics.

days.topic: Privacy, Masking and Test Data Management
subtopics: Masking rules that keep data usable
days.lab_task: Create a masked and subsetted copy of production for testing that keeps referential integrity, and handle a data subject deletion request across systems.
days.deliverable: Masking rules, test database and deletion evidence

subtopics: Automated deployment through the REST API
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that exports assets on merge, runs unit and reconciliation tests in test, deploys to production after approval and rolls back on failure.
checks: Deployed to test with tests run

days.lab_task: Plan a migration of 2,000 PowerCenter workflows in waves, convert and test one wave with automation and write the cutover and hypercare plan.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, wave results and cutover plan

subtopics: Data across on-premises and several clouds
Agent placement for cost and speed
days.lab_task: Design and build integration that moves data from on-premises to AWS and Azure under residency rules, with agents placed to cut transfer cost.
checks: No traffic over the public internet

subtopics: Pushdown and elastic choices for cost
days.lab_task: Find the top IPU consumers, change three jobs to cheaper patterns, remove unused jobs and report monthly savings.
checks: Lower IPUs with the same output

days.topic: AI in Informatica: CLAIRE and Generative AI Features
days.lab_task: Use CLAIRE to suggest mappings and quality rules, check each suggestion, use natural-language requests to build a simple pipeline and write rules for AI use.
days.deliverable: Suggestion review, generated pipeline and AI rules
checks: Rules for checking AI output defined

days.lab_task: Design the support model for the platform, plan for the next IDMC release, automate agent upgrades and write a monthly platform health report.
days.deliverable: Support model, release plan and health report

days.topic: Informatica and Alternatives: Cloud-Native ETL and ELT Tools
subtopics: Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue and Dataflow
tools: Azure Data Factory or AWS Glue
days.lab_task: Build the same load in Informatica and in a cloud-native stack, compare effort, governance, run time and total cost and recommend tools for three use cases.
Diagnose five injected incidents (an agent out of disk, a source password change, a slow lookup after data growth, CDC lag and a bad data load), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Integration Strategy and Centre of Excellence
days.lab_task: Write an integration strategy and centre of excellence plan for a company, with standards, intake, training and a 12-month roadmap, and present it to leadership.
checks: Clear rules and reusable assets listed

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Integration and Governance Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build an integration and governance platform for a case company: hybrid runtimes, CDC and APIs, a quality programme, a customer master, catalogue and lineage, DevOps, cost reporting and a migration wave, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, assets, pipelines, reports and board presentation
checks: Source change reaches the master and the warehouse
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
